name: shiksha-document-reader-tutorial
title: Read and navigate generated notes

chapters.caption: 01  Ask your course TA to turn an explanation into structured study notes.
02  Follow the document being created through the real artifact renderer.
03  Open the saved document, then enter full screen for focused reading.
04  Use the document-section rail to jump straight to the worked example.
05  Return to the conversation without losing the generated notes.

description: Generate a study document, open the real reader, use full screen and jump between sections.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
